instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery needs three distinct phases. Phase one: quiet, slow, thoughtful. Phase two: a furious climax, very loud and very fast. Phase three: quiet, slow, sad resignation.
text: Uno intenta construir algo, pieza por pieza, con cuidado. ¡Y luego llegas tú y lo destruyes todo en un segundo sin pensarlo! Y yo... me quedo aquí, entre las ruinas.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a low-pitched, sad voice. Transition into a more neutral, pensive delivery with a normal pitch by the end.
text: Esa casa ya no está, la demolieron hace años. A veces me pregunto si los lugares guardan los ecos de las risas que una vez contuvieron.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is extremely rushed and flat, failing to demonstrate the requested emotional and pitch transitions.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The voice sounds rushed and flat without conveying sadness or a thoughtful transition.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The pitch gradually lowers throughout the sentences, ending in a normal vocal range as requested.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Begin this line in a very slow, very quiet manner. As you speak, build to a normal volume and speed, as if a thought is solidifying in your mind.
